headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea leading the way to sign Bournemouth's Scott

headline: Jordan Pickford ignored give-way sign, almost caused crash, court hears
description: England goalkeeper Jordan Pickford nearly caused a crash with two other cars during a bout of careless driving in his £200,000 Lamborghini supercar, a court has heard.

headline: JJ Gabriel representatives demanded game time at Manchester United - sources
description: Representatives of JJ Gabriel demanded that the teenager played at least 20 minutes in games against Sabah FK, Brighton and Bournemouth before beginning talks about signing a scholarship with Manchester United, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Ledley King backs Tottenham form to 'turn around very quickly'
description: Ledley King has urged Roberto De Zerbi's team to draw on the experiences of last season to end the club's winless start to the new Premier League campaign.

headline: How a mass Man City player exodus would warp the transfer market
description: If Manchester City are punished by being relegated from the Premier League, group of players worth more than £1 billion in transfer fees would suddenly become available.
